requirement.node_extent: U5 acceptance IDs AC-01, AC-02, AC-04, AC-05, AC-06. SF-REQ-051-AC-03 is outside the U5 node extent and is neither mapped nor claimed here.

review.basis: Predicate statements are the verified design probes of contract SF-REQ-051 (acceptance_design_trace) and its two BLOCKING enforcement obligations, independently VERIFIED by POSTW1-VERIFY-010, together with the SF-REQ-051 acceptance criteria text. Runnable bindings (fixture, command, endpoint, guard) are PRODUCER-authored for FX-U5 and are themselves a judgment obligation of the independent VERIFIER. Nothing here is inferred from implementation code or passing tests.

predicates.statement: Inspect complete proportional contract and explicit inapplicability reasons against pinned requirements/architecture.
inputs: DesignContract fixture documents with every AC-01 field present, a field missing, and a field inapplicable without a reason
predicates.expected: a complete contract whose satisfied requirements equal its pinned requirement revisions reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED after the existing architecture checks; a missing field holds INCOMPLETE_DESIGN, an inapplicable field without an explicit reason holds UNEXPLAINED_INAPPLICABILITY, and a requirement link mismatch holds REQUIREMENT_LINK_MISMATCH

predicates.statement: Material undecided behavior/API/persistence/security blocks; bounded helper freedom allowed.
inputs: a decision inventory with an OPEN BEHAVIOR, PUBLIC_API, PERSISTENCE or SECURITY decision
an OPEN IMPLEMENTATION_LOCAL choice with and without an explicit bound
a review whose blocking finding names a disguised material decision
predicates.expected: any open material decision holds UNRESOLVED_MATERIAL_DECISION, an unbounded local choice holds UNBOUNDED_LOCAL_CHOICE, a bounded local choice stays open and reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED, and a VERIFIED review carrying a blocking finding is refused BLOCKING_FINDINGS

predicates.statement: Reviewer rejects impossible premise using pinned capability evidence despite internal checklist green.
inputs: a complete, internally consistent DesignContract whose premise demands CREDENTIAL_DENIAL
U3 pinned premise mapping docs/evidence/wo-220203-fx-u3-premise-mapping.json and its retained PY-09B and PY-10 artifacts
predicates.expected: the mechanical report carries the U3 InfeasibleProof(UNACHIEVABLE_PREMISE) evidence and holds INFEASIBLE_PREMISE although every checklist field is complete; a VERIFIED review of that design is refused MECHANICAL_HOLD_OUTSTANDING, and an attributed REJECTED review is retained

predicates.statement: Whether a proposed criterion is a satisfiable platform premise, and whether an inapplicability reason is proportional, remains an attributed independent reviewer judgment that no mechanical result replaces.
predicates.decision_record: Issue #97 VERIFIER result comment for the exact candidate SHA

predicates.statement: Changed required revision invalidates design/downstream applicability; old evidence retained.
inputs: a VERIFIED design, then a changed requirement revision in the downstream revision vector
a VERIFIED design, then a new design revision changing a fixed decision
predicates.expected: DesignApplicability.check returns Stale naming the changed vector keys and records design.stale; a new design revision returns Held REVIEW_REQUIRED and the old vector Stale; the prior design, mechanical report and VERIFIED review stay readable in the append-only history

predicates.statement: Require fresh independent review and exact revision vector for downstream compilation/readiness. Replay self-review or stale design review and require downstream hold; conforming independent control passes.
inputs: a review whose reviewer actor or invocation equals the producer's
a VERIFIED review replayed after the design revision changed
a review from an actor outside the configured reviewer authority
predicates.expected: self-review holds SELF_REVIEW, a shared invocation holds SELF_REVIEW, a replayed review holds STALE_REVIEW, an unauthorized reviewer holds UNAUTHORIZED_REVIEWER, a review recorded before any mechanical report holds NO_MECHANICAL_REPORT, and in every refused case downstream readiness is refused; the conforming independent review makes the design CurrentVerified and readiness admits it

predicates.statement: No design/independent passing review/authority means readiness hold without Project mutation.
inputs: a design whose admission depends on the open directional authority
predicates.expected: readiness processing refuses NO_DESIGN, REVIEW_REQUIRED and MECHANICALLY_HELD respectively; the operational store holds only upstream:design aggregates and LifecycleStage is unchanged (IMPLEMENT, VERIFY, REVIEW, ACCEPT, DONE)

predicates.statement: Run existing repository-wide architecture checks and composed port compatibility probes; return ARCHITECTURE_AUTHORITY_HOLD for direction-dependent admission while R2-GAP-051-EDGE-AUTHORITY is open. observed_edges is descriptive, never a permission table.
inputs: tools/fitness/check_architecture.py over src/alienintent and over the existing tests/fixtures/fitness/layering fixture
an interface manifest whose consumer requires an input the producer does not provide
a design declaring a cross-module dependency edge, including one listed in observed_edges
predicates.expected: all five existing checks run before review and their results are in the report; a forbidden adapter import holds ARCHITECTURE_CHECK_FAILED and an incompatible consumer input holds INCOMPATIBLE_INTERFACE; any declared dependency edge holds ARCHITECTURE_AUTHORITY_HOLD while the gap is open, even when the edge appears in observed_edges
